integrity.computational_checks: reduced mod-two ranks, graph membership, exact signed Lefschetz and full character averages
integrity.proof_basis: symbolic cofiber splitting, skeleton matching, integral augmented chains and join signs

scientific_limitations: The homotopy equivalence is nonequivariant; only the integral homology modules are described equivariantly.
The graph family assumes at least two clique blades, each of size at least three, and higher-independence thresholds at least two.
Rational quotient acyclicity is not integral quotient acyclicity or contractibility.
Finite exact checks corroborate but are not substituted for the unrestricted topological proof.
Unindexed equivalent work is not excluded by the searches.
title: Integral homotopy and wreath-product homology of higher-independence windmill complexes
